name: Tori Fergana
source:
Karumu's mother. She was a famous actress who feared aging due to birds having shorter life spans than most other animals. As a result, she forced her son to become a "replica" of herself.

After he started middle school and began showing more masculine traits, she abandoned him and moved in with another man. She then had more children.
